message: Open the account menu and choose Tutorial and Help to replay at any time.
Welcome: start the optional guide, skip for now, or close it.
1 of 4: choose your unit yourself. The tutorial never selects a unit for you.
2 of 4: find task navigation on your unit dashboard.
3 of 4: locate Select Target Grade. Reading the guide does not change your grade.
4 of 4: find Calendar options. The tutorial creates no subscription.
Finish closes the guide. The written tutorial remains available from every panel.
Replay is always available for eligible students while the institution switch is on.
